title: Model Zoo Cartography: task rank is imprinted in the input layer — corpus instruments, analysis, and paper
description: Code, audited instruments, tests, figures, and paper draft for Model Zoo Cartography: 1,569 bias-free ReLU MLPs trained at the ARC White-Box Estimation Challenge Phase-1 architecture and censused against the analytic random-init null. Headline result: the input weight matrix of every converged net carries exactly C-1 significant dimensions under the analytic Marchenko-Pastur floor — the rank of the class-mean simplex — with the learned deep code shared across same-task twins only up to an orthogonal transformation, and the random weight bulk shown functionally inert. The weights corpus with full per-net training provenance is public at huggingface.co/datasets/james-ra-henry/MZC-Corpus.
